diagnostics.message: names "undo" as its compensator, but "undo" declares a compensator of its own. That asks what undoes the undo, and the regress has no authored end — so it has to end here, at the build. A compensator must declare `{terminal: "irreversible" | "harmless", why: "…"}`.
